name: Lark (Larksuite)
description: Communications and messaging: Lark's collaboration suite (messaging, docs, calendar, Base) with a large Open Platform API.
access_notes: Developers create a custom app self-serve in the Lark Developer Console (free Lark account) and get App ID + App Secret. Server calls use tenant_access_token obtained by exchanging app credentials (client-credentials-like but non-standard endpoint); user_access_token uses an OAuth/OIDC login flow. Store (marketplace) apps require review and app_ticket handling.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP: larksuite/lark-openapi-mcp (@larksuiteoapi npm tool) documented on open.larksuite.com, wrapping OpenAPI as MCP tools with tenant/user token auth. No Composio Lark toolkit found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/lark.md, /larksuite.md and composio.dev/toolkits/lark all 404).
uncertainty_notes: Token acquisition (app_id + app_secret -> tenant_access_token) resembles OAuth2 client credentials but uses Lark-specific endpoints, so it is tagged 'custom'. Tokens are presented as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Event subscriptions can use either webhook POSTs or a WebSocket persistent connection (custom apps only).

evidence.note: Three access token types: app_access_token, tenant_access_token, user_access_token; obtained via auth-v3 endpoints with App ID/Secret.
Tokens passed as 'Bearer' in Authorization header; tenant_access_token recommended for app-identity calls; user_access_token obtained via OIDC flow.
Official 'OpenAPI MCP Tool' covering messages, groups, calendar, Base; supports tenant and user access tokens.
'Feishu/Lark official OpenAPI MCP tool' in the official larksuite GitHub org.
Event subscriptions via traditional webhook (HTTP POST to your server) or WebSocket persistent connection.
